scope: Generic classical tabular ensemble preprocessing: fold-fitted mixed-table cleaning and encoding.
checks: Missing category distinct from all literal strings
Query population cannot alter fitted statistics
Training-fold median differs from leaked full-population median
Invalid tables and all-constant numeric rejection
limits: Explicit caller numeric/string columns, no automatic source-schema inference
Dense one-hot/frequency features; high-cardinality resource costs unqualified
All-null numeric columns use zero and drop as constants
No target encoding or label input
